summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the billing requirements and rates for services provided to the Interdan account (AKE). It was confirmed that all sums must be presented in USD, not EUR. A specific rate of $450 is being charged for Interdan on the AKE account for June. Additionally, a mandatory bank commission fee of 25 EUR will be added if a separate invoice is issued to the AKE.
decisions: Interdan billing must use USD currency.
$450 charge confirmed for Interdan on AKE (for June).
A 25 EUR bank commission fee will be added for separate AKE invoicing.
